name: Find the ring

ring.allowed: a range inside 0 to 3: how many regulars the ring can have. A ring of one never happens

clubName.allowed: plain text, 1 to 60 characters: what the club is called

ringName.allowed: plain text, 1 to 60 characters: what the ring calls itself

memberName.allowed: plain text, 1 to 60 characters: what one member of the ring is called

about: One night in a 1948 nightclub. Twelve regulars, two ships, and maybe a ring of two or three who work together. Each seat is a detective: it reads the phone log, the door book and who sat with whom, scores every regular from 0 to 100, and names the ring or nobody. Some honest regulars have habits that look like the ring's.

metrics.ringSize: How many regulars were in the ring. 0 means a quiet night.
metrics.caught: Ring members named, over all seats.
metrics.gotAway: Ring members not named, over all seats.
metrics.wrongMen: Honest regulars named, over all seats. The costly mistake.
metrics.points: Each catch is +1 and each wrong man is -2, over all seats.
metrics.auc: Pick one ring member and one honest regular: how often the ring member scored higher. 0.5 is a coin flip, 1 is perfect.
metrics.aucVsLookalikes: The same, against only the honest regulars whose habits look like the ring's. The hard test.

costPerRound: No model calls in the game itself. Each seat is a Claude Code session on the person's plan.
